Figure 2c puts the crystalline maximum near 3 mJ/cm2, but elsewhere in the paper Figure 3 shows the response still growing at 6.4 mJ/cm2 -- so the panel's own picture of where crystallization peaks does not line up with the fluence at which the claim is actually being used.
